limits: Original MGS3 PS2 pre-eye-injury Naked Snake identity; no eye patch or cross-incarnation fusion. Near natural eye visible; far eye hidden by profile is not certified from invisible pixels.

Root physically inspected the entire32-role contact, four weapon/hand zooms, independent full native KO/face diagnostic, and official Konami camouflage plate. Independent peer inspected original selected PNGs, contours and separate gait near-limb ownership. Source masks alone do not prove anatomy or literal retail fidelity.
Fresh independent two-facing drawings and two authored gait contact keyposes perface; no mirrored frame or full original walk-cycle certificate.

KO14 is accepted as a distinct relaxed whole-body prone state supported on the forearm, compared with raised crouching roll15. Eyes partly obscured by the pose; no claim of visibly shut eyes. No source was changed to force a posture.

Same-page neutral heights retained; no anatomical height was inferred from prone alpha width. Mummy mixed-page RIGHT gait H480 and LEFT reload H491 aliases are distinct; selected left walk uses H492. Root visual inspection and peer review found no gross source-density mismatch.

Mk22 gun/suppressor outline and manually reviewed muzzle/rear axis, and empty hand-release points belong to exact roles11/9. Actual both-facing game origins, costume preview/pause and original regressions remain required.
The camouflage is a reference-based newly drawn2D adaptation, with visible original palette and pattern family. Fine unseen surfaces and exact retail pattern placement/animation are not certified.
